sections: 3.3.6.1 two-component value space and equal iff identical
observation: P400Y and P146097D have distinct months/seconds but coincide at all four reference instants because the Gregorian calendar repeats every400years.
decision: Component equality stays exact and disjoint from decimal/string. A bound comparison whose four projections all coincide but whose components differ returns Unsupported, rather than asserting equality or invalidity under conflicting REC statements.
